about: Mix-and-match sections for law-firm homepages, from 12 Dribbble full-page references in this folder (1–12.webp; shot links in _sources.json). Every mockup = one base STYLE + an ordered set of SECTIONS from different references. Crops live in sections/<id>.jpg (scripts/crop-sections.py). These designs are carried by portrait photography of the attorneys and by big confident headlines: use the lead's real attorney headshots and office photos first, then legal stock (scales of justice, columns, books, meeting rooms). Every number (years, cases won, $ recovered, ratings) must come from the lead's FACTS — otherwise drop the stat.
